sectors.name: VOYAGES
sectors.tagline: Long games to sink an evening into.

sectors.name: AFTER HOURS
sectors.tagline: Four slower games for the end of the day.

apps.name: ORBIT LOCK
apps.subtitle: Catch a wandering satellite.
apps.description: Acquire the amber gate as your satellite crosses it. Each lock tightens the window, and later sectors reverse the orbit and set the gate drifting. Three missed alignments end the expedition.
apps.controls: PRESS AT THE GATE

apps.name: MOONRUNNER
apps.subtitle: Dive the slopes. Fly the crests.
apps.description: Fly a survey sled over the rolling hills of the moon before the night catches it. Hold to make the sled heavy and dive down a slope; let go to make it light and fly off the crest. Come down along a downslope for a perfect slide and a burst of speed; three in a row is fever. Every zone reached buys more daylight. Dust pits, rilles to fly over, boost crystals and gas vents; survey orders that unlock sleds and zen riding, a workshop and a daily run. In the air the middle lamp turns green when a landing would be perfect; the right lamp is the daylight.
apps.controls: HOLD TO DIVE · LET GO TO FLY

apps.name: UNDERTOW
apps.subtitle: Follow the silent current.
apps.description: Pilot a small craft down through an impossible ocean. Hold to rise, release to sink, and thread the openings between ancient columns through six zones of currents, dark water and breathing vents. Gather pearls for new craft at the dock (hold on the title screen), try the daily dive, earn feats. The lamps show your depth and where the next opening is.
apps.controls: HOLD TO RISE · RELEASE TO SINK

apps.name: ECHO VAULT
apps.subtitle: Learn Morse by keying words.
apps.description: Transmissions approach the vault: key each word in Morse before its timer runs out (tap a dot, hold a dash). It starts with four letters and opens one more whenever the ones you have are holding up; a letter’s code shows at once while it is new and later as it grows stronger. Echo transmissions are heard, not shown: key back what you heard, or hold for a second to hear it again. Letters learned in Signal School are open here too. Thirty transmissions open the vault; hold on the title for the code card.
apps.controls: TAP A DOT · HOLD A DASH

apps.name: LIGHT TRIAL
apps.subtitle: Measure the space before action.
apps.description: Press to arm a trial. Wait for the middle physical light to turn green. ESP32 button trials use the node clock; keyboard trials use approximate screen timing.
apps.controls: WAIT FOR LIGHT II · THEN PRESS

apps.name: RELAY
apps.subtitle: Hear the rhythm. Carry it on.
apps.description: The lamps play a bar of a real rhythm, then go dark: tap it back in time, and the next call follows on the beat. Seven stages of rhythms from the pulse through tresillo, clave, waltz, swing and odd time, then faster cycles. New rhythms show their notation; learned ones are played by heart. Hold on the title for the songbook: daily run, studio practice, accelerando, sound kits and the rhythm book.
apps.controls: WATCH AND LISTEN · TAP THE RHYTHM BACK · HOLD ON TITLE: SONGBOOK

apps.name: MERIDIAN
apps.subtitle: Catch the light on the called lamp.
apps.description: A light swings across the lamps. The screen calls one (LEFT, MIDDLE or RIGHT; on four lamps INNER LEFT and INNER RIGHT too): tap as the light reaches it. The title shows how, and HOW TO PLAY has the rules. Let red swings pass; read changes of tempo, dark swings and feints. Hold on the title for the observatory: daily run, sprint, eclipse, light colours and the sky chart.
apps.controls: WATCH THE LAMPS · TAP ON THE CALLED LAMP · HOLD ON TITLE: OBSERVATORY

apps.name: GLYPH ARCHIVE
apps.subtitle: Learn real symbols, card by card.
apps.description: Four wings: Braille letters, the Greek alphabet, chemical element symbols and the radio alphabet. Each card shows a symbol and a meaning: tap if they match, hold if they do not, before the card runs out. New entries are shown first, a few at a time, and come back on a spaced schedule until they are mastered; wrong pairs are chosen to be easy to confuse. Hold on the title to change wing.
apps.controls: TAP: MATCH · HOLD: NO MATCH

apps.name: PERIHELION
apps.subtitle: Swing between small suns.
apps.description: Hold to tether to the nearest anchor and swing. Release to fly on. Cross six regions to the perihelion, find relics, earn feats. Hold on the title for the hangar.
apps.controls: HOLD TO TETHER · RELEASE TO FLY · HOLD ON TITLE: HANGAR

apps.name: HIGH BAR
apps.subtitle: Skate the bowl. Swing the bars. String tricks.
apps.description: Ride a skate park and chain tricks into combos. Near a bar, hold to swing and release to fly; on the ground, hold to pump and release to ollie; in the air, hold to flip and let go to land upright. Land clean to bank the combo. Two-minute sessions, four parks with goals, three save slots (hold on the title).
apps.controls: HOLD: SWING · PUMP · FLIP · RELEASE: FLY · OLLIE · LAND · HOLD ON TITLE: SETUP

apps.name: DESCENT
apps.subtitle: Set down gently, or not at all.
apps.description: Hold to burn against gravity and settle on the pad before the fuel runs out. The lamps are your descent-rate indicator.
apps.controls: HOLD TO BURN · RELEASE TO FALL

apps.name: RICOCHET
apps.subtitle: Break the lattice.
apps.description: The paddle never stops. Tap to reverse it and keep the signal bouncing through the lattice. The first chamber is practice.
apps.controls: TAP TO REVERSE THE PADDLE

apps.name: BALLISTA
apps.subtitle: Fire the pod as far as it will go.
apps.description: Press to fix the sweeping aim, hold to charge, release to fire. Pads, mines and boosters throw the pod on; drifts, nets and sinkholes stop it. In flight a press fires a thruster, or skips the pod if it is about to land. Salvage buys upgrades in the workshop.
apps.controls: HOLD TO CHARGE · RELEASE TO FIRE · PRESS IN FLIGHT

apps.name: TIDELINE
apps.subtitle: Something is on the line.
apps.description: Charge a cast, wait for the bite, then hold and release to keep the catch zone on the fish. Alien waters, thirty species, a field log and better gear. Playable by the lamps alone.
apps.controls: HOLD TO CAST AND LIFT THE ZONE · TAP FOR GEAR AND LOG

apps.name: OUTPOST
apps.subtitle: Build something that runs without you.
apps.description: Tap to gather signal, and every tap plays the next note of a melody at your own tempo; each tune makes the machines tuned to its notes hum. Hold to open the build ring: buy machines, choose the tune, run research. Relocate to new sites, each with its own rules and soundings to take, and decode the call hidden in the signal. The station keeps working while you are away.
apps.controls: TAP TO GATHER AND PLAY · HOLD FOR THE RING

apps.name: SIGNAL SCHOOL
apps.subtitle: Speak in dots and dashes.
apps.description: Learn the alphabet through a progressive Morse lesson. A letter moves on after two correct answers in a row. The lights and optional sidetone follow your key, and replay the right signal after a mistake. Beginner letter gaps are deliberately forgiving.
apps.controls: TAP A DOT · HOLD A DASH

apps.name: CHRONOMETER
apps.subtitle: Keep time beyond this screen.
apps.description: Create up to eight persistent background timers. The nearest one is shown large and drains across the three lamps while this screen is open. A completed timer announces itself without interrupting a game’s physical lights.
apps.controls: TAP NEXT · HOLD TO CHOOSE

apps.name: FIELD NOTES
apps.subtitle: Let the room tell its story.
apps.description: Local speech-to-text with visible microphone status, saved sessions, and text export. Recording continues when you leave this screen; mute is always in the system menu.
apps.controls: TAP NEXT · HOLD TO CHOOSE

apps.name: ATMOSPHERE
apps.subtitle: Observe the world around you.
apps.description: Temperature and humidity from your SHT3x with dew point, feels-like, absolute humidity, today’s extremes, the hourly trend and a comfort verdict shown on the lamps. History charts for 24 hours, 7 days and 30 days. Simulator readings are explicitly marked and stored separately.
apps.controls: TAP NEXT · HOLD TO CHOOSE

apps.name: NODE SCOPE
apps.subtitle: Look inside the instrument.
apps.description: Live button state, node link and firmware, sensor bus diagnostics, light-channel checks with the lamp level, microphone level, sensor readings, and communication counters.
apps.controls: TAP NEXT · HOLD TO CHOOSE

apps.name: CALIBRATION
apps.subtitle: Make the console your own.
apps.description: Sound, volume, phosphor texture, reduced motion, Morse speed, and button hold duration. All controls work with one button.
apps.controls: TAP NEXT · HOLD TO CHOOSE

apps.name: LANTERN
apps.subtitle: Carry a little light.
apps.description: The three lamps as a lamp: colours, brightness and slow scenes, with a night-light that switches itself off.
apps.controls: TAP NEXT · HOLD TO CHOOSE

apps.name: CADENCE
apps.subtitle: Count the beat and the laps.
apps.description: A metronome with tap tempo, a stopwatch with laps, and work/rest intervals shown on the lamps.
apps.controls: TAP NEXT · HOLD TO CHOOSE

apps.name: EPHEMERIS
apps.subtitle: Know where the sky is.
apps.description: The time, the Moon's phase, sunrise and sunset for your location, and a small orrery. All computed locally.
apps.controls: TAP NEXT · HOLD TO CHOOSE

apps.name: RESONANCE
apps.subtitle: See what the room sounds like.
apps.description: Sound level, spectrum and pitch from the microphone. Nothing is recognised or stored.
apps.controls: TAP NEXT · HOLD TO CHOOSE

apps.name: ORACLE
apps.subtitle: Ask the dark for a number.
apps.description: Dice, coins, random picks and yes-or-no answers, rolled across the lamps.
apps.controls: TAP NEXT · HOLD TO CHOOSE

apps.name: TELEMETRY
apps.subtitle: Listen to the machine itself.
apps.description: Health of the Pi and the node: temperature, load, memory, storage, link and firmware.
apps.controls: TAP NEXT · HOLD TO CHOOSE

apps.name: CRAWLSPACE
apps.subtitle: A hammer, a drill, and a deeply unreasonable house.
apps.description: A turn-based household roguelike through three increasingly strange levels. Tap to move between swing, brace and drill, then hold and release to act; enemies announce their next move and wait for you. Build synergies from useful junk, choose repairs or risky rooms, defeat the house's three bosses, then try a tougher crawl.
apps.controls: TAP: NEXT CARD · HOLD + RELEASE: DO IT · ENEMIES WAIT

apps.name: SUPPER CLUB
apps.subtitle: Three pans. One button. A house full of hungry people.
apps.description: Run a small supper club through four dinner services. Tap to move between pans and hold and release to cook, plate or clean; the kitchen slows while you hold. Combine rice, greens and eggs into ticketed meals. Limited stock, food freshness and three chosen kitchen upgrades make every service a different balancing act.
apps.controls: TAP: NEXT PAN · HOLD + RELEASE: COOK / PLATE · HOLDING SLOWS TIME

apps.name: POCKET LINKS
apps.subtitle: Nine small courses. Big little decisions.
apps.description: Play a full nine-hole round with real bank shots, water, rough, ice and sloping greens. Tap to switch a precise putter for a wall-hopping wedge; hold to freeze the aiming arrow and release to choose power. Plan safe routes or daring shortcuts, with three water mulligans for the round.
apps.controls: TAP CLUB · HOLD AIM · RELEASE POWER

apps.name: NIGHT GRID
apps.subtitle: Keep the neighborhood glowing until dawn.
apps.description: Restore three neighborhood circuits through ten storm-night shifts. Invest repair kits in feeders, smart meters and cross-ties, then route limited power using visible demand forecasts. Shops earn supplies, stored water cushions outages, and a stable neighborhood builds your score. Nothing happens until you pick: tap to move between cards, hold and release to pick one.
apps.controls: TAP: NEXT CARD · HOLD + RELEASE: PICK · NO TIME LIMIT

apps.name: THE STACKS
apps.subtitle: A shelf of books, one page at a time.
apps.description: A library of DRM-free books: EPUB and text files, fifteen classics on the shelf and more to fetch, and your Kindle highlights. Tap turns the page; hold for the reader's menu.
apps.controls: TAP: NEXT PAGE · HOLD & RELEASE: MENU
